Report on how the committee reviewed and concluded the matter of the Member of the People's Majlis for Kendhoo constituency, Mahmood Thariq, being taken into police custody during a protest being held by fishermen on 11 December 2025

Report number: M20/R/IS/2026/2
21 October 2026

Privileges Committee

The responsibilities of this committee are: to look into and review matters submitted to the committee relating to the privileges of the Majlis and of members and the conduct of members of the Majlis; to check whether anything has happened that diminishes the privileges of members; if they have been diminished, to review it, find and state the cause, and state the action to be taken; to identify measures that can be taken to prevent such a thing from happening in future and to determine additional measures and additional procedures needed in implementing those measures; when a member is accused of doing something contrary to the law and the rules, to look into and investigate it and advise the Speaker of the Majlis on the action to be taken; to give advice and oversight relating to keeping the actions of members, officers or staff in line with ethical standards; to set the procedure for accepting and giving gifts; to set and implement the procedures and standards for members' submission of financial statements; and to prepare and submit reports to the Majlis relating to these matters.

3. How the committee carried out its work

Article 259 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis states that information that a member of the People's Majlis has been detained, [?] to the Speaker of the People's Majlis or the Secretary General as provided in Article 258 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, must be notified to this committee in writing within 24 (twenty-four) hours, and that upon such notification, this committee must meet to look into the matter of the member being under police custody. Accordingly, when this committee received information that the Member of the People's Majlis for Kendhoo constituency, Mahmood Thariq, had been taken into police custody during a protest being held by fishermen on 11 December 2025, the committee held its 13th meeting of 2025 on 11 December 2025 and deliberated on the matter in committee.
